# Figure 1

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tibble)

COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES <- c("IA", "MN", "MO", "OK")

df_epi <- final_data %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    state = as.character(state),
    date = as.Date(date),
    hosp = as.numeric(Hospital.Admissions)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(date) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    median_hosp = median(hosp, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_states = dplyr::n_distinct(state),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(date)

stopifnot(
  nrow(df_epi) == 70,
  all(df_epi$n_states == 46),
  all(is.finite(df_epi$median_hosp))
)

study_dates <- df_epi$date
x_min <- study_dates[1]
x_max <- study_dates[70]

# Five folds: 20-week training, 10-week evaluation.
fold_y <- tibble::tibble(fold = 1:5, y_mid = c(5.4, 4.3, 3.2, 2.1, 1.0))
bar_half_height <- 0.48

fold_overlay <- purrr::map_dfr(1:5, function(i) {

  train_start_i <- 1 + (i - 1) * 10
  train_end_i   <- train_start_i + 19
  eval_end_i    <- train_end_i + 10

  boundary <- study_dates[train_end_i] + 3.5

  tibble::tibble(
    fold = i,
    period = c("Training", "Evaluation"),
    xmin = c(study_dates[train_start_i], boundary),
    xmax = c(boundary, study_dates[eval_end_i])
  )
}) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(fold_y, by = "fold") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ymin = y_mid - bar_half_height,
    ymax = y_mid + bar_half_height
  )

stopifnot(nrow(fold_overlay) == 10, all(is.finite(fold_overlay$y_mid)))

fold_labels <- fold_overlay %>%
  dplyr::filter(period == "Training") %>%
  dplyr::transmute(fold, x = xmin + 7, y = y_mid, label = paste0("Fold ", fold))

p_fig1_overlay <- ggplot() +
  geom_area(
    data = df_epi,
    aes(x = date, y = median_hosp),
    fill = "grey80", color = NA
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = fold_overlay,
    aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = period),
    alpha = 0.50, color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = df_epi,
    aes(x = date, y = median_hosp),
    color = "black", linewidth = 0.65
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = fold_labels,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, size = 4.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Training" = "#F2C94C", "Evaluation" = "#8FBC78"),
    breaks = c("Training", "Evaluation")
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    limits = c(x_min, x_max),
    date_breaks = "2 months",
    date_labels = "%b\n%Y",
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 6.2),
    breaks = c(0, 2, 4, 6),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Median observed admissions", fill = NULL) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      keywidth = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
      keyheight = grid::unit(0.50, "cm"),
      override.aes = list(alpha = 0.50)
    )
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.2, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = grid::unit(0.50, "cm"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.7),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.6),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 14, 10, 10)
  )

print(p_fig1_overlay)

ggsave(
  "Fig1_epidemic_CV_overlay_final.png",
  p_fig1_overlay,
  width = 12, height = 6.8, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
prepare_bars <- function(tbl) {

    dplyr::filter(k %in% 1:11) %>%

      x = factor(k, levels = 1:11),

df1 <- prepare_bars(best_state_median_with_hosp_46_by_k)
df2 <- prepare_bars(best_state_median_no_hosp_46_by_k)

)

square_width <- 0.37
legend_x <- 0.7

graph <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = df2, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3) +

  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = legend_x, xmax = legend_x + square_width,
    ymin = legend_y, ymax = legend_y - square_size,

  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = legend_x + square_width + 0.10,
    y = legend_y - square_size / 2,

  ) +
  annotate(
    "rect",

    ymax = legend_y - 2 * square_size - 0.04,
    fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = legend_x + square_width + 0.10,
    y = legend_y - square_size * 1.5 - 0.04,
    label = "Including hospital admissions",
    hjust = 0, size = 3.7
  ) +
  labs(x = "Number of covariates", y = "RMSE") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max), clip = "off") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 10)

graph

ggsave("Fig2_rmse_by_model_size.png", graph,
```

# Figure 3

```{r}
source_list <- c(
  "Wearing Masks", "Symptoms", "Symptoms in Community", "Outpatient Visits",
  "Test Positivity", "Cases", "Deaths", "Vaccinations",
  "Policy Index", "Climate", "Hospital Admissions", "ED Visits"
)

parse_predictor_numbers <- function(x) as.integer(strsplit(x, ",\\s*")[[1]])

trunc3 <- function(x) trunc(x * 1000) / 1000

# Univariate models, sorted by RMSE. 
res_k1 <- all_state_median_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(k == 1) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    predictor_idx = as.integer(predictor_numbers),
    Source = source_list[predictor_idx]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(median_state_rmse_46)

df_ind <- data.frame(
  Source = factor(res_k1$Source, levels = rev(res_k1$Source)),
  Value = res_k1$median_state_rmse_46,
  type = "univariate"
)

source_levels <- levels(df_ind$Source)

# Bivariate models pairing each predictor with hospital admissions,
# ordered to match the univariate panel
res_k2 <- all_state_median_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(k == 2) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(predictor_idx_list = purrr::map(predictor_numbers, parse_predictor_numbers)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(purrr::map_lgl(predictor_idx_list, ~ 11L %in% .x)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    other_idx = purrr::map_int(predictor_idx_list, ~ .x[.x != 11L]),
    other_name = source_list[other_idx]
  ) %>%
  dplyr::slice(match(setdiff(res_k1$Source, "Hospital Admissions"), other_name))

df_pred <- data.frame(
  Source = factor(res_k2$other_name, levels = source_levels),
  Value = res_k2$median_state_rmse_46,
  type = "combined"
)

df_comb <- dplyr::bind_rows(df_ind, df_pred)

df_seg <- df_pred %>%
  dplyr::left_join(df_ind %>% dplyr::select(Source, Value_orig = Value), by = "Source")

stopifnot(
  nrow(res_k1) == 12, nrow(res_k2) == 11,
  nrow(df_ind) == 12, nrow(df_pred) == 11, nrow(df_seg) == 11,
  all(is.finite(df_comb$Value)),
  all(is.finite(df_seg$Value_orig))
)
```

```{r}
compute_state_median_46 <- function(lag_suffix) {

  purrr::map_dfr(1:12, function(k) {

    object_name <- paste0("comb", k, "_median_vac.", lag_suffix)
    if (!exists(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      stop("Object not found: ", object_name)
    }

    pred_list  <- get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)$y_predicted_new
    combo_list <- combn(1:12, k, simplify = FALSE)

    purrr::imap_dfr(pred_list, function(pred_tibble, combo_index) {

      pred_common_46 <- pred_tibble %>%
        dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES)

      n_common_states <- dplyr::n_distinct(pred_common_46$state)
      if (n_common_states != 46) {
        stop("lag=", lag_suffix, ", k=", k, ", combo_index=", combo_index,
             ": ", n_common_states, " states")
      }

      state_rmse_46 <- pred_common_46 %>%
        dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop")

      tibble::tibble(
        k = k,
        combo_index = combo_index,
        predictor_numbers = paste(combo_list[[combo_index]], collapse = ", "),
        median_state_rmse_46 = median(state_rmse_46$rmse)
      )
    })
  })
}

best_of_each_size <- function(tbl) {
  tbl %>%
    dplyr::arrange(k, median_state_rmse_46, combo_index) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(k) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
}

best_lag1_46_by_k <- best_of_each_size(compute_state_median_46("lag1"))
best_lag2_46_by_k <- best_of_each_size(compute_state_median_46("lag2"))
best_lag3_46_by_k <- best_of_each_size(all_state_median_results)

selected_sources <- best_lag3_46_by_k %>%
  dplyr::arrange(k) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(predictor_idx_list = purrr::map(predictor_numbers, parse_predictor_numbers)) %>%
  dplyr::pull(predictor_idx_list) %>%
  lapply(function(idx) source_list[idx]) %>%
  setNames(paste0("comb", 1:12))

df_selected <- expand.grid(Source = source_levels, Combination = paste0("comb", 1:12))
df_selected$Selected <- 0

for (comb in paste0("comb", 1:12)) {
  df_selected$Selected[
    df_selected$Combination == comb & df_selected$Source %in% selected_sources[[comb]]
  ] <- 1
}

df_selected$Combination <- factor(
  gsub("comb", "", df_selected$Combination),
  levels = as.character(1:12)
)
df_selected$Source <- factor(df_selected$Source, levels = source_levels)

# ymin = 1 week, yline = 2 weeks, ymax = 3 weeks
strip_data <- data.frame(
  Combination = factor(1:12),
  ymin  = trunc3(best_lag1_46_by_k$median_state_rmse_46),
  yline = trunc3(best_lag2_46_by_k$median_state_rmse_46),
  ymax  = trunc3(best_lag3_46_by_k$median_state_rmse_46)
)
```

```{r}
FIG3_STRIP_LIMITS <- c(0.3, 1.4)

plot_rmse <- ggplot() +

plot_heatmap <- ggplot(

) +

strip_segment <- function(y_var, width) {
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(Combination) - 0.5,
      xend = as.numeric(Combination) + 0.5,
      y = .data[[y_var]], yend = .data[[y_var]]
    ),
    color = "black", linewidth = width
  )
}
```

```{r}
short_months <- function(p) {
  p + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b")
}

upright_x_top <- theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 6),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 0, l = 5)
)

upright_x_bottom <- theme(
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 6),
  plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5)
)

remove_y_axis <- function(p) {
  p + theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.line.y = element_blank()
  )
}

top_with_state <- function(p, state_name, keep_y = FALSE) {
  p <- p +
    labs(x = state_name) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none") +
    upright_x_top

  if (!keep_y) p <- remove_y_axis(p)
  p
}

plot_with_and_without_hosp_new <- function(
    state_name, pred_with, pred_without,
    ylim_range = c(0, 12),
    col_without = "darkgreen", col_with = "steelblue"
) {

  clean_theme <- theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black")
  )

  data_with <- pred_with %>%
    dplyr::filter(state == state_name) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(model = "With hospital admissions")

  data_without <- pred_without %>%
    dplyr::filter(state == state_name) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(model = "Without hospital admissions")

  stopifnot(
    nrow(data_with) == 50,
    nrow(data_without) == 50,
    identical(data_with$date, data_without$date),
    isTRUE(all.equal(data_with$obs, data_without$obs, tolerance = 0)),
    all(is.finite(data_with$pred)),
    all(is.finite(data_without$pred))
  )

  make_graph <- function(data, xlab_text = "") {
    ggplot(data, aes(x = date)) +
      geom_point(aes(y = obs), color = "black", size = 1) +
      geom_line(aes(y = pred, color = model), linewidth = 0.8) +
      coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim_range) +
      labs(x = xlab_text, y = "Hospital admissions", color = NULL) +
      scale_color_manual(values = c(
        "Without hospital admissions" = col_without,
        "With hospital admissions" = col_with
      )) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7)) +
      clean_theme
  }

  list(
    without = make_graph(data_without, xlab_text = "Without hospital admissions"),
    with = make_graph(data_with, xlab_text = "With hospital admissions")
  )
}
```

```{r}
best_overall <- function(has_hosp) {
  all_state_median_results %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_hospitalization == has_hosp) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(median_state_rmse_46, k, combo_index) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)
}

best_with_hosp_46_overall    <- best_overall(TRUE)
best_without_hosp_46_overall <- best_overall(FALSE)

k_with      <- best_with_hosp_46_overall$k
idx_with    <- best_with_hosp_46_overall$combo_index
k_without   <- best_without_hosp_46_overall$k
idx_without <- best_without_hosp_46_overall$combo_index

stopifnot(
```

```{r}
period_marker <- function(lines_df, ranges_df, colour, label_size) {
  list(
    geom_segment(
      data = lines_df,
      aes(x = start, xend = start, y = 0, yend = rect_ymin),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, color = colour, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    geom_rect(
      data = ranges_df,
      aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = rect_ymin, ymax = rect_ymax),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = colour, color = NA
    ),
    geom_text(
      data = ranges_df,
      aes(x = midpoint, y = text_y, label = label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "white", fontface = "bold",
      size = label_size, vjust = 0.5, lineheight = 0.8
    )
  )
}
```

# Figures S2 and S3

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

stopifnot(exists("COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES"))

source_list <- c(
  "Wearing Masks", "Symptoms", "Symptoms in Community", "Outpatient Visits",
  "Test Positivity", "Cases", "Deaths", "Vaccinations",
  "Policy Index", "Climate", "Hospital Admissions", "ED Visits"
)

compute_all_median_46 <- function(lag_suffix) {

  purrr::map_dfr(1:12, function(k) {

    object_name <- paste0("comb", k, "_median_vac.", lag_suffix)
    if (!exists(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      stop("Object not found: ", object_name)
    }

    pred_list  <- get(object_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)$y_predicted_new
    combo_list <- combn(1:12, k, simplify = FALSE)

    if (length(pred_list) != length(combo_list)) {
      stop("lag=", lag_suffix, ", k=", k,
           ": number of predictions does not match number of combinations")
    }

    purrr::imap_dfr(pred_list, function(pred_tibble, combo_index) {

      predictor_vector <- combo_list[[combo_index]]

      pred_common_46 <- pred_tibble %>%
        dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES)

      if (dplyr::n_distinct(pred_common_46$state) != 46) {
        stop("lag=", lag_suffix, ", k=", k, ", idx=", combo_index,
             ": expected 46 states")
      }

      state_rmse_46 <- pred_common_46 %>%
        dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop")

      tibble::tibble(
        lag = lag_suffix,
        k = k,
        combo_index = combo_index,
        predictor_numbers = paste(predictor_vector, collapse = ", "),
        predictor_names = paste(source_list[predictor_vector], collapse = ", "),
        has_hospitalization = 11L %in% predictor_vector,
        median_state_rmse_46 = median(state_rmse_46$rmse)
      )
    })
  })
}

all_lag1_46 <- compute_all_median_46("lag1")
all_lag2_46 <- compute_all_median_46("lag2")
all_lag3_46 <- compute_all_median_46("lag3")
```

```{r}
trunc3 <- function(x) trunc(x * 1000) / 1000

best_by_k <- function(all_df, has_hosp) {
  all_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_hospitalization == has_hosp, k %in% 1:11) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(k) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(median_state_rmse_46, combo_index, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      x = factor(k, levels = 1:11),
      y_full = median_state_rmse_46,
      y = trunc3(median_state_rmse_46)
    )
}

make_decomp_plot <- function(all_df, out_png) {

  df1 <- best_by_k(all_df, TRUE)
  df2 <- best_by_k(all_df, FALSE)

  df_pct <- data.frame(
    x = df1$x,
    pct = round((df2$y_full - df1$y_full) / df2$y_full * 100, 1),
    mid_y = (df1$y + df2$y) / 2
  )

  y_max <- max(c(df1$y, df2$y)) + 0.3

  square_size <- 0.12
  square_width <- 0.37
  legend_x <- 0.7
  legend_y <- y_max + 0.1

  graph <- ggplot() +
    geom_col(data = df2, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_col(data = df1, aes(x = x, y = y), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.75) +
    geom_text(
      data = df_pct,
      aes(x = x, y = mid_y, label = paste0(pct, "%")),
      color = "black", size = 3.3
    ) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = legend_x, xmax = legend_x + square_width,
      ymin = legend_y, ymax = legend_y - square_size,
      fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.3
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = legend_x + square_width + 0.10,
      y = legend_y - square_size / 2,
      label = "Excluding hospital admissions", hjust = 0, size = 3.7
    ) +
    annotate(
      "rect",
      xmin = legend_x, xmax = legend_x + square_width,
      ymin = legend_y - square_size - 0.04,
      ymax = legend_y - 2 * square_size - 0.04,
      fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.75
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = legend_x + square_width + 0.10,
      y = legend_y - square_size * 1.5 - 0.04,
      label = "Including hospital admissions", hjust = 0, size = 3.7
    ) +
    labs(x = "Number of covariates", y = "RMSE") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, y_max), clip = "off") +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 14),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 30, 10, 10)
    )

  ggsave(out_png, graph, width = 6.5, height = 4, dpi = 300)

  list(graph = graph, df_pct = df_pct)
}

figS2 <- make_decomp_plot(all_lag1_46, "FigS2_rmse_decomposition_1week.png")
figS3 <- make_decomp_plot(all_lag2_46, "FigS3_rmse_decomposition_2week.png")

print(figS2$graph)
print(figS3$graph)
```

# Figure S4

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)


ADMISSIONS_INDEX  <- 11L
N_STATES_EXPECTED <- 46L
HEATMAP_HORIZON   <- 3L

stopifnot(source_list[ADMISSIONS_INDEX] == "Hospital Admissions")

combo_members <- function(k, idx) as.integer(combn(12, k, simplify = FALSE)[[idx]])

all_rmse <- purrr::map_dfr(1:3, function(h) {
  purrr::map_dfr(1:12, function(k) {

    obj_name <- sprintf("comb%d_median_vac.lag%d", k, h)
    if (!exists(obj_name)) stop("Object not found: ", obj_name)

    purrr::imap_dfr(get(obj_name)$y_predicted_new, function(pred_tbl, combo_index) {

      state_rmse <- pred_tbl %>%
        dplyr::mutate(state = as.character(state)) %>%
        dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES) %>%
        dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)), .groups = "drop")

      tibble::tibble(
        horizon = h,
        k = k,
        combo_index = as.integer(combo_index),
        median_rmse = median(state_rmse$rmse),
        n_states = nrow(state_rmse)
      )
    })
  })
}) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    members = list(combo_members(k, combo_index)),
    has_admissions = ADMISSIONS_INDEX %in% members
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

expected_counts <- all_rmse %>%
  dplyr::count(horizon, k, name = "n_combos") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(expected = choose(12, k))

stopifnot(
  all(all_rmse$n_states == N_STATES_EXPECTED),
  all(is.finite(all_rmse$median_rmse)),
  all(expected_counts$n_combos == expected_counts$expected)
)

univ_k1 <- all_rmse %>%
  dplyr::filter(horizon == HEATMAP_HORIZON, k == 1) %>%
  dplyr::rowwise() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Source = source_list[members[[1]]]) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(median_rmse)

stopifnot(nrow(univ_k1) == 12L, !anyDuplicated(univ_k1$Source))

source_levels <- rev(univ_k1$Source)

best_by_size <- function(include_admissions) {
  all_rmse %>%
    dplyr::filter(has_admissions == include_admissions) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(horizon, k) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(median_rmse, combo_index, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::arrange(horizon, k)
}

best_with    <- best_by_size(TRUE)
best_without <- best_by_size(FALSE)

stopifnot(
  identical(sort(unique(best_with$k)), 1:12),
  identical(sort(unique(best_without$k)), 1:11)
)

make_strip_data <- function(best_tbl) {
  best_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(horizon, k, median_rmse) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = horizon, values_from = median_rmse,
                       names_prefix = "h") %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      Combination = factor(k, levels = sort(unique(k))),
      ymin = trunc3(h1),
      yline = trunc3(h2),
      ymax = trunc3(h3)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Combination)
}

make_df_selected <- function(best_tbl) {

  b <- best_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(horizon == HEATMAP_HORIZON) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(k)

  selected <- setNames(
    lapply(seq_len(nrow(b)), function(i) source_list[b$members[[i]]]),
    paste0("comb", b$k)
  )

  df <- expand.grid(Source = source_levels, Combination = names(selected),
                    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$Selected <- 0L

  for (cmb in names(selected)) {
    df$Selected[df$Combination == cmb & df$Source %in% selected[[cmb]]] <- 1L
  }

  df$Combination <- factor(
    gsub("comb", "", df$Combination),
    levels = as.character(sort(as.integer(gsub("comb", "", names(selected)))))
  )
  df$Source <- factor(df$Source, levels = source_levels)
  df
}

strip_data_with <- make_strip_data(best_with)
strip_data_without <- make_strip_data(best_without) %>%
  dplyr::filter(as.character(Combination) != "12") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Combination = droplevels(Combination))

df_selected_with <- make_df_selected(best_with)
df_selected_without <- make_df_selected(best_without) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Combination != "12") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Combination = droplevels(Combination))

size_check <- df_selected_without %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Combination) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(n_sel = sum(Selected), .groups = "drop") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(k = as.integer(as.character(Combination)))

stopifnot(
  all(df_selected_with$Selected[df_selected_with$Source == "Hospital Admissions"] == 1),
  sum(df_selected_without$Selected[df_selected_without$Source == "Hospital Admissions"]) == 0,
  all(size_check$n_sel == size_check$k)
)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

Y_LIMITS <- c(0.3, 1.5)
Y_BREAKS <- seq(0.4, 1.4, by = 0.2)

strip_segment <- function(y_var, width) {
  geom_segment(
    aes(
      x = as.numeric(Combination) - 0.5,
      xend = as.numeric(Combination) + 0.5,
      y = .data[[y_var]], yend = .data[[y_var]]
    ),
    color = "black", linewidth = width
  )
}

make_panel <- function(df_selected, strip_data) {

  heatmap_plot <- ggplot(
    df_selected,
    aes(x = as.numeric(Combination), y = Source, fill = factor(Selected))
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "grey80", alpha = 0.8, width = 1, height = 1) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = 1:12, expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("0" = "white", "1" = "steelblue"),
      labels = c("0" = "excluded", "1" = "included"),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_y_discrete(limits = source_levels, expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(x = "Number of predictors included", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90")
    )

  strip_plot <- ggplot(strip_data) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = as.numeric(Combination) - 0.5, xend = as.numeric(Combination) - 0.5,
          y = ymin, yend = ymax),
      color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      aes(x = as.numeric(Combination) + 0.5, xend = as.numeric(Combination) + 0.5,
          y = ymin, yend = ymax),
      color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    strip_segment("ymin",  0.5) +
    strip_segment("yline", 0.9) +
    strip_segment("ymax",  1.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = 1:12, expand = expansion(add = 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = Y_BREAKS, limits = Y_LIMITS) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = Y_LIMITS) +
    labs(y = "RMSE", x = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      text = element_text(color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 7),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "black", size = 8),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0)
    )

  (strip_plot / heatmap_plot) + plot_layout(heights = c(1, 5))
}

legend_df <- data.frame(
  x = 1,
  y = 5:1,
  type = factor(
    c("included", "excluded", "1 week", "2 weeks", "3 weeks"),
    levels = c("included", "excluded", "1 week", "2 weeks", "3 weeks")
  )
)

legend_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_tile(
    data = subset(legend_df, type %in% c("included", "excluded")),
    aes(x = x, y = y, fill = type),
    width = 0.4, height = 0.25, color = "grey50", alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = subset(legend_df, type %in% c("1 week", "2 weeks", "3 weeks")),
    aes(x = x - 0.3, xend = x + 0.3, y = y, yend = y,
        linetype = type, linewidth = type),
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("included" = "steelblue", "excluded" = "white"),
    breaks = c("included", "excluded")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("1 week" = "solid", "2 weeks" = "solid", "3 weeks" = "solid")
  ) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c("1 week" = 0.5, "2 weeks" = 0.9, "3 weeks" = 1.5)
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8, colour = "black")
  )

labels_df <- data.frame(
  Source = source_levels,
  y = seq(1, by = 0.22, length.out = length(source_levels))
)

label_plot <- ggplot(labels_df, aes(x = 1.54, y = y, label = Source)) +
  geom_text(hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size = 2.9) +
  coord_cartesian(
    xlim = c(0.7, 1.5),
    ylim = c(min(labels_df$y) - 0.3, max(labels_df$y) + 0.3),
    clip = "off"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 35, r = 0, b = 5, l = 5))

final_two_panels <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  label_plot,
  make_panel(df_selected_with, strip_data_with),
  make_panel(df_selected_without, strip_data_without),
  cowplot::get_legend(legend_plot),
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(0.49, 1, 1, 0.29),
  labels = c("", "A", "B", ""),
  label_size = 12,
  label_y = 0.99
)

final_two_panels

ggsave("FigS4_predictor_selection_with_without.png",
       final_two_panels, width = 8, height = 4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
library(usmap)
library(scales)
library(grid)


if (!exists("pred_with_final_46")) {
  pred_with_final_46 <- get("comb6_median_vac.lag3", envir = .GlobalEnv)$y_predicted_new[[105]] %>%
    dplyr::transmute(state = as.character(state), date = as.Date(date), obs, pred) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES)
}

rmse_with_final_46 <- pred_with_final_46 %>%
  dplyr::group_by(state) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    rmse = sqrt(mean((pred - obs)^2)),
    n_predictions = dplyr::n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(rmse_with_final_46) == 46,
  all(rmse_with_final_46$n_predictions == 50)
)

rmse_levels <- c("<0.75", "0.75–0.99", "1.00–1.24",
                 "1.25–1.49", "1.50–1.99", "≥2.00", "Excluded")

map_rmse_with_50 <- usmap::us_map(regions = "states") %>%
  dplyr::distinct(abbr) %>%
  dplyr::rename(state = abbr) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(rmse_with_final_46, by = "state") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    rmse_group = dplyr::case_when(
      state %in% COMMON_EXCLUDE_STATES ~ "Excluded",
      rmse < 0.75 ~ "<0.75",
      rmse < 1.00 ~ "0.75–0.99",
      rmse < 1.25 ~ "1.00–1.24",
      rmse < 1.50 ~ "1.25–1.49",
      rmse < 2.00 ~ "1.50–1.99",
      TRUE ~ "≥2.00"
    ),
    rmse_group = factor(rmse_group, levels = rmse_levels)
  )

rmse_palette <- c(
  "<0.75"     = "#F7FBFF",
  "0.75–0.99" = "#DEEBF7",
  "1.00–1.24" = "#C6DBEF",
  "1.25–1.49" = "#9ECAE1",
  "1.50–1.99" = "#6BAED6",
  "≥2.00"     = "#2171B5",
  "Excluded"  = "#D9D9D9"
)

p_figS5 <- plot_usmap(
  data = map_rmse_with_50,
  values = "rmse_group",
  regions = "states",
  color = "grey25",
  linewidth = 0.25
) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = rmse_palette,
    drop = FALSE,
    name = "State-specific RMSE",
    guide = guide_legend(override.aes = list(color = NA, linewidth = 0))
  ) +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9.5, face = "plain"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.42, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0.10, "cm"),
    legend.key = element_rect(color = NA),
    legend.background = element_blank(),
    legend.box.background = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 10, 5, 5)
  )

p_figS5

ggsave("FigS5_state_rmse_map.png", p_figS5,
       width = 7.2, height = 4.4, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)


state_pages <- split(
  sort(unique(as.character(pred_with_final_46$state))),
  ceiling(seq_len(46) / 8)
)

stopifnot(
  length(unlist(state_pages)) == 46,
  length(state_pages) == 6
)

add_without_forecast <- function(base_plot, state_name) {

  without_data <- pred_without_final_46 %>%
    dplyr::filter(state == state_name) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(date)

  base_plot +
    geom_line(
      data = without_data,
      aes(x = date, y = pred, color = "Without hospital admissions"),
      inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9
    )
}

make_state_panel <- function(state_name, y_max) {

  base_plot <- plot_with_and_without_hosp_new(
    state_name,
    pred_with_final_46,
    pred_without_final_46,
    ylim_range = c(0, y_max)
  )[[2]]

  short_months(add_without_forecast(base_plot, state_name))
}

legend_state <- state_pages[[1]][1]

legend_with_and_without <- cowplot::get_legend(
  make_state_panel(legend_state, 12) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
)

make_eight_state_page <- function(states) {

  page_with <- pred_with_final_46 %>% dplyr::filter(state %in% states)
  page_without <- pred_without_final_46 %>% dplyr::filter(state %in% states)

  y_max <- max(
    12,
    ceiling(max(c(page_with$obs, page_with$pred, page_without$pred)) * 1.05 * 2) / 2
  )

  state_full_names <- state.name[match(states, state.abb)]

  
  panel_plots <- lapply(seq_along(states), function(i) {

    base_plot <- make_state_panel(states[i], y_max) +
      theme(legend.position = "none") +
      upright_x_bottom

    keep_y <- i %in% c(1, 5)

    if (keep_y) base_plot <- base_plot + labs(y = "Hospital Admissions")

    top_with_state(base_plot, state_name = state_full_names[i], keep_y = keep_y)
  })

  while (length(panel_plots) < 8) {
    panel_plots <- append(panel_plots, list(patchwork::plot_spacer()))
  }

  main_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    cowplot::ggdraw(patchwork::wrap_plots(panel_plots[1:4], ncol = 4)),
    cowplot::ggdraw(patchwork::wrap_plots(panel_plots[5:8], ncol = 4)),
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1, 1),
    align = "v",
    axis = "lr"
  )

  cowplot::plot_grid(
    main_plot,
    legend_with_and_without,
    ncol = 1,
    rel_heights = c(1, 0.12)
  )
}

all46_pages <- lapply(state_pages, make_eight_state_page)

purrr::walk(all46_pages, print)

dir.create("Fig_S6_all_states", showWarnings = FALSE)

purrr::iwalk(all46_pages, function(p, i) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path("Fig_S6_all_states",
                         sprintf("FigS6_page_%02d.png", as.integer(i))),
    plot = p,
    width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
})
```
